data.taskBrief:
Query a flow's endpoint request error-rate metric for production incident triage (Meta WhatsApp Flows API)

FIT
Partially. The supplied request retrieves an endpoint request error-rate metric, which supports incident triage, but no supplied request provides broader investigation or end-to-end incident-resolution capabilities. All supplied requests serve the task.

AUTH
Bearer token authentication
Header: Authorization: Bearer <access-token>. The collection references {{access-token}}, but does not provide its value.

BASE URL
https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0

STEPS
1. GET /{flow-id}
   Params:
     flow-id: string — '<FLOW_ID>'; place in the path.
     fields: string — 'metric.name(ENDPOINT_REQUEST_ERROR_RATE).granularity(LIFETIME).since(2024-01-28).until(2024-01-30)'; place in the query string. This requests the endpoint request error-rate metric for the specified date range.
   Returns:
     200 OK; an object containing id (string), metric.granularity (string), metric.name (string), and metric.data_points (array). Each data point shown contains timestamp (string) and data (array) with key (string) and value (number); the example value is 0.12625250501002.
   Threading:
     None

GOTCHAS
- Replace {{base-url}} with https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0 and {{flow-id}} with the target flow ID.
- Supply a valid access token for {{access-token}}; its value is not included in the provided collection context.
- URL-encode the fields query value as needed, while preserving the metric name, granularity, and since/until date filters.
- The collection description marks this WhatsApp Flows API collection as deprecated and directs users to the Flows folder in the WhatsApp Cloud API collection.
